description: This Java class defines a command handler for activating SMS campaigns within the Apache Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses annotations for transaction management, dependency injection, and command type specification. The main method processes incoming JSON commands by invoking a service to activate an SMS campaign identified by the command's entityId.

classes.name: ActivateSmsCampaignCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the activation of SMS campaigns upon receiving a command, using dependency injection and transactional processing.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to activate an SMS campaign, delegating the action to the SmsCampaignWritePlatformService.
